open_points.subject: A2 rule 3 camera date validation
open_points.text: is no valid calendar date and time
open_points.question: Which calendar and time rules define validity, particularly whether a matching value with a leap second such as second 60 is usable and, if so, how it is converted to a datetime?
options: Accept a leap second and normalize it to the following minute.
Reject second 60 as an invalid camera time and try the next photo-moment source.
open_points.default_guess: Use proleptic Gregorian datetime rules and reject second 60.

witness.initial: A decodable source has DateTimeOriginal matching EXIF_DATETIME_PATTERN with value 2016:12:31 23:59:60, OffsetTimeOriginal +00:00, and a modification time just after that instant; all plausibility limits pass.
events: The deliverer validates DateTimeOriginal and selects the first usable photo moment.
outcomes: The implementation accepts the leap second, normalizes it to 2017-01-01T00:00:00, and records date_source as exif.
The implementation rejects DateTimeOriginal and uses DateTime or the file modification time instead.
witness.observer: The calling flow and Portal observe a different photo_date, and the stored placement may have a different date_source.

open_points.subject: A2 rule 3 EXIF value representation
open_points.text: A camera value is unusable when it does not match the imported `EXIF_DATETIME_PATTERN` constant whole
open_points.question: In which representation is an EXIF camera value matched: only a string already returned by the image library, or may a byte-valued tag be decoded or otherwise coerced first; if decoding is allowed, which encoding and error rule apply?
options: Only a string value can match; every other library-returned type is unusable.
Decode byte-valued EXIF tags with a specified encoding before applying the pattern.
Convert any library-returned value to text before applying the pattern.
open_points.default_guess: Accept only the image library's string representation and treat every other type as unusable.

witness.initial: A decodable source has DateTimeOriginal represented by the image library as ASCII bytes containing a pattern-valid date, no usable DateTime tag, and a usable modification time.
events: The deliverer reads DateTimeOriginal and applies the whole-pattern validity rule.
outcomes: The implementation decodes the bytes, accepts the EXIF instant, and records date_source as exif.
The implementation treats the non-string value as unusable and uses the file modification time.
witness.observer: The calling flow and Portal observe a different photo_date and date_source.
